407:t_1:86.en:
$$マオ$$
「He sure went all out, though. He slaughtered them all.」

407:t_1:87.en:
$n
「If they threaten our habitat, I guess he has no choice.」

407:t_1:88.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, I'd expect a $$ビーストハンター$$ like you to say that.」

407:t_1:89.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Oh... So you used to do that kind of work, too, $n.」

407:t_1:91.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$ティティ$$... You've really settled into life on the ship.」

407:t_1:92.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I hear she boarded with $$エイミー$$ in the confusion while we were chasing $$レド$$ and the others.」

407:t_1:93.en:
$$ティティ$$
「The fleet was fun, but life with $c seems more exciting.」

407:t_1:94.en:
$$クラン$$
「Hold on! Are you... planning to stay here?」

407:t_1:95.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That's okay, right? I'm... pretty good at housework and stuff.」

407:t_1:96.en:
$$マオ$$
「It's true the housekeeping crew is always shorthanded, but...」

407:t_1:97.en:
$$クラン$$
「Are you sure about this? Don't you have family in the fleet?」

407:t_1:98.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...My dad and big brother died in the $$時空震動$$...」

407:t_1:100.en:
$$ティティ$$
「After that, my mom lost it... It seemed like... she hated me...」

407:t_1:102.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So I... didn't want to end up hating my mom... and I left home, but...」

407:t_1:103.en:
$$クラン$$
「I-I'm sorry, $$ティティ$$... I had no idea you'd been through all that...」

407:t_1:104.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It's okay. I'm... happy now.」

407:t_1:106.en:
$$宗介$$
「So she lost a parent in the $$時空震動$$, too...」

407:t_1:108.en:
$$カレン$$
「Do you feel sorry for her?」

407:t_1:110.en:
$n
(So seeing her calms me down because, somewhere inside, I sensed that she and I had something in common...)

407:t_1:113.en:
$$シェリル$$
「It'll be okay. $$レド$$ will come back. I'm sure of it.」

407:t_1:114.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But... when $$レド$$ comes back, he might not be the $$レド$$ I know...」

407:t_1:116.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Nobody will tell me the details, but $$レド$$ killed a lot of $$クジライカ$$, didn't he...?」

407:t_1:118.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I tried hard to understand why $$レド$$ did something like that, but...」

407:t_1:119.en:
$$アルト$$
「Even so, $$レド$$ is still $$レド$$.」

407:t_1:121.en:
$$アルト$$
「He lived inside a cage called the $$人類銀河同盟$$. But now he's a bird that's escaped it and gained his freedom.」

407:t_1:123.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's that freedom that's confusing him. He's torn between how he used to live and how he'll live now... wondering how to fly.」

407:t_1:124.en:
$$アルト$$
「But I believe in what he was born with... that awkward kindness of his.」

407:t_1:125.en:
$$宗介$$
「I agree with $$アルト$$. He's finally starting to understand that he's a human before he's a soldier.」

407:t_1:126.en:
$n
「He's probably torn between his duty as an Alliance soldier and his own judgment right now.」

407:t_1:127.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You all... really pay attention to $$レド$$, don't you...?」

407:t_1:128.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You do too, don't you, $$エイミー$$?」

407:t_1:130.en:
$$アルト$$
「There's the $$エイミー$$ we know, at last.」

407:t_1:131.en:
$$シェリル$$
「That was a nice thing to say, $$アルト$$.」

407:t_1:133.en:
$$シェリル$$
「You mean... you've been a bird that's gained its freedom?」

407:t_1:135.en:
$$アルト$$
(I've found something to protect and the strength to go on living. $$レド$$... I believe you'll find your wings, too.)

407:t_1:138.en:
$$マオ$$
「Why don't you stop grinning and help $$ランカ$$ out, big brother?」

407:t_1:140.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Then what are you looking at?」

407:t_1:141.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The $$ランカ$$ I remembered was a little girl who always followed me around...」

407:t_1:142.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Seeing her worry about someone and comfort them like that makes me happy.」

407:t_1:143.en:
$$マオ$$
「...You win. You really are a knight in shining armor.」

407:t_1:144.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well... go ahead and dote on your sister to make up for the decade or more you spent apart.」

407:t_1:145.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「That's what I intend to do.」

407:t_1:147.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「It can't be the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$... can it?」

407:t_1:148.en:
$$キャシー$$
「We have confirmed $$サイデリアル$$'s approach. All mobile unit personnel, prepare to sortie.」

407:t_1:149.en:
$$宗介$$
「So destroying that $$クジライカ$$ research unit has brought the nearby forces here.」

407:t_1:150.en:
$$マオ$$
「If they're coming to us, that's convenient. We'll crush them and bring peace to this sea!」

407:t_2:3.en: ～$$ガルガンティア船団$$　Fleet Commander's Room～

407:t_2:4.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...I'm sorry to put you through this... indulging my last selfish request...」

407:t_2:6.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Here... I've watched over $$ガルガンティア$$... for a long time...」

407:t_2:9.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I was here during that storm they call the $$時空震動$$, too...」

407:t_2:10.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「So... I want to meet my end here, too.」

407:t_2:11.en:
$$リジット$$
「...Captain $$ジェフリー$$... has reported that they've wiped out $$サイデリアル$$'s forces...」

407:t_2:12.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「What news is there of $$フランジ$$?」

407:t_2:13.en:
$$リジット$$
「We haven't heard anything since they attacked the $$クジライカ$$ nest.」

407:t_2:15.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「$$リジット$$... From now on, you'll forge the fleet's future.」

407:t_2:17.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Don't be afraid of change. The sea... and the world are changing...」
